name: CCF Summer Programs
description_short: Connecting for Children & Families, a Woonsocket non-profit, runs summer learning camps by grade: Camp Discovery (K-2), Chillin' and Skillin' (3-5) and Get Connected (6-8), a career-exploration camp. Camps run July through mid-August.
